title: Remove exhaust manifolds, heat shields and O2 sensors

notices.text: Heat and penetrant, then patience. Plan on snapping at least one manifold stud and plan the extraction in advance (weld a nut on rather than drill, if you can get to it). Remove the O2 sensors with a slotted sensor socket and do not hang them by their wires. All manifold gaskets and nuts are one-time-use.

steps.text: Remove exhaust manifolds, heat shields and O2 sensors.

fasteners.name: Exhaust manifold nuts

stages.label: NOT VERIFIED IN RESEARCH — consult factory manual

fasteners.note: Use new copper-plated lock nuts and new gaskets; anti-seize the studs on assembly.

fasteners.name: Oxygen sensors
fasteners.note: Never install an O2 sensor with anti-seize on the sensing tip.

sources.ref: WSM Gr.1 Part 1 (M96/01 edition) p.1-5 (M18, M96/01 edition)
